items.name: base
items.title: Prometheus Base
items.description: Prometheus design-system defaults for a new app. Locks Base UI, Geist, Heroicons, warm paper tokens, the type ramp, breakpoint tokens, and the @prometheus namespace. Install this with shadcn init instead of composing a theme by hand.

theme.font-sans: Geist, Geist Fallback, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
theme.font-mono: Geist Mono, Geist Mono Fallback, ui-monospace, monospace

items.name: changelog
items.title: Prometheus 0.2.0
items.description: Current registry version is 0.2.0. Compare it with the // @prometheus stamp in a copied file, then re-add items that are behind. Installing this writes PROMETHEUS.md.

items.name: starter
items.title: Prometheus starter
items.description: A Next.js app with every Prometheus component installed and the system wired: Base UI, soft radius, default size, Heroicons, system theme, umber accent. Configure further from the docs Make them yours panel.

theme.font-sans: Geist, Geist Fallback, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
theme.font-mono: Geist Mono, Geist Mono Fallback, ui-monospace, monospace

items.docs: Docs: https://prometheus-ui-rust.vercel.app. Copy the install prompt from any docs page to bake in your Make them yours choices.

items.name: setup
items.title: Prometheus setup
items.description: Install every Prometheus component and system lib into an existing shadcn app. Use --overwrite. Then wrap the root in Providers from components/providers.tsx.

theme.font-sans: Geist, Geist Fallback, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
theme.font-mono: Geist Mono, Geist Mono Fallback, ui-monospace, monospace

items.docs: After install, wrap children in <Providers /> from components/providers.tsx. Docs: https://prometheus-ui-rust.vercel.app

items.name: motion
items.title: Motion
items.description: Shared durations, easing, and the height spring. Import these instead of inventing a second curve.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: Portable Prometheus extension tokens derived from the host theme. Ships --hover / --hover-light / --active / --selected and Tailwind color bridges so Fluid Hover, Slider fills, and controls work without this app’s globals.css. Depends on motion.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: Type ramp from text-xs through text-5xl. Each step sets size, line-height, and tracking. Titles from text-xl use font-display. Long-form copy uses prose. Drop caps use drop-cap (2 lines), drop-cap-3, or drop-cap-4.

items.name: breakpoints
items.title: Breakpoints
items.description: Viewport widths sm through xl. The app frame splits at md: below it, usePrometheus().isMobile is true and the sidebar is a sheet.

items.name: smooth-corners
items.title: Smooth Corners
items.description: Lisse squircles for Prometheus panels and overlays. CORNERS match --radius* tokens. Squircle curve with smoothing 1 by default. Use useCornerRef on Base UI popups; Elevated and overlays already apply it. Pill and circle stay CSS rounded-full.

items.name: elevated
items.title: Surfaces
items.description: Eight nested surface levels from Fluid Functionalism. Overlays read their substrate and lift so dialogs, selects, and drawers stay visible at any depth in light and dark mode. PrometheusProvider starts the ladder at surface 1. Panels use Lisse smooth corners by default.

items.name: fluid-hover
items.title: Fluid Hover
items.description: One highlight that glides from item to item under the pointer instead of blinking between them. List, Sidebar, Checkbox group, and Radio group already use it. Installs theme (hover tokens) and motion.

items.name: springs
items.title: Springs
items.description: Critically damped spring tiers for pointer-driven motion. Prefer these over hand-written durations.

items.name: omit
items.title: Omit
items.description: Shallow omit helper for stripping props before spreading onto a host element.

items.name: font-weight
items.title: Font weight
items.description: Variable-font weight tokens for fontVariationSettings, paired with opsz so weight changes keep width steady.

items.name: size-context
items.title: Size
items.description: Two-step size ladder (default and compact). SizeProvider pins a region; components read useSizeVariant.

items.name: shape-context
items.title: Shape
items.description: Corner shape ladder: sharp, rounded, and pill. ShapeProvider sets the variant; components read useShape.

items.name: chart-palette
items.title: Chart palette
items.description: Six pastel colors for charts and badges, ordered so neighbouring hues stay apart under common color vision types. Soft tags clear 7:1.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Base UI button on Prometheus tokens: an elevated default plus five fallback variants, control-height sizes, inline icons, and the shared focus ring. Pill stays CSS rounded-full.

items.name: toggle-button
items.title: Toggle button
items.description: Base UI toggle on the default Button: raised when off, flat on a muted fill when selected. Control-height sizes, inline icons, and a group for single or multiple selection.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A hairline square. Checked, it fills with foreground and a surface-colored Heroicons check. Pair with Field.

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: Checkbox group
items.description: Checkbox rows with Fluid Hover and contiguous selections that merge into one background. Each row uses a filled check.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A labeled toggle. The thumb stretches on hover and press, springs across the track, and can be dragged past the midpoint to flip.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: Radio rows styled like Checkbox group: Fluid Hover, a muted selection fill, and a filled control with a surface-colored dot. Circles stay CSS rounded-full.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Base UI text input on Prometheus tokens: a bordered default or a filled muted wash, control-height sizes, start and end slots, a pending check, and invalid, read-only, and disabled states. Form wires it up as FormInput.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text field on the Input tokens: grows with the text between rows and maxRows, a character or word count, an optional grab handle, and invalid, read-only, and disabled states. Form wires it up as FormTextarea.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Base UI dialog that lifts four surface steps off its substrate and uses Lisse smooth corners.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Base UI select whose menu lifts two surface steps off its substrate, so it stays visible inside a dialog. Menu uses Lisse smooth corners.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Base UI menu that lifts two surface steps off its substrate, with Lisse smooth corners, radio and checkbox items, and nested submenus.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: One slider, two ladder steps: the default pip/scrubber design and the compact design with range mode and value display. Built on Base UI with spring motion.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Base UI tooltip that lifts two surface steps off its substrate, with Lisse smooth corners, collision-aware positioning, and composable parts for advanced layouts.

items.name: lightbox
items.title: Lightbox
items.description: ramka lightbox on Prometheus tokens: a morph from the thumbnail, swipe, pinch to zoom, pull to dismiss, and Button controls, plus a gallery that builds the whole viewer from an array of images.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Base UI drawer that lifts on the same surface ladder as Dialog, with Lisse smooth corners on the free edge.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Base UI sheet that lifts four surface steps off its substrate, inset 8px from the window edge with Lisse smooth corners all round.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: TanStack Table and Virtual, with cells that split, stretch, and snap as the container widens. Merged values strain toward their column, then click into place.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Collapsible sidebar that uses usePrometheus().isMobile and becomes a sheet on a narrow viewport. Drag the rail to resize: open to one fixed width, or learn the width you keep choosing and snap to it. Prefer AppShell for the app frame.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.description: Sidebar, top bar, scrolling main, and a one-row footer. App screens start here. The root layout stays fonts and PrometheusProvider.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Skullet skeletons in Prometheus tokens. Wrap the loaded view; the skeleton is measured from it, so nothing moves when the data lands.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: Empty state with an icon slot, a title, one sentence, and actions.

items.name: error
items.title: Error
items.description: Error state with an icon slot, a title, one sentence, and actions.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: react-hook-form and zod. Field errors, a root error, and a submit button that shows Spinner while pending.

items.name: data-display
items.title: Data display
items.description: Recharts-powered bar and line chart cards, ChartContainer, ChartCard, ChartTooltip, ChartLegend, and ChartKey. Bars use pastel fills; lines stay monochrome. Hairline grid, in the app's own font, with a value tag on hover. Charts fade in on scroll, and reduced motion keeps the end state.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Soft pill labels on the Data Foundations pastel palette, plus a neutral muted default. A translucent tint sits over the local surface so the wash stays stable on any parent.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Image or initials avatar and a see-through AvatarStack. Every dimension derives from --avatar-size, and stacked neighbours are cut with a real CSS mask so any background shows through the gaps.

items.name: list
items.title: List
items.description: Rows of links between hairline rules, with a title on the left and a detail on the right. One Fluid Hover fill glides from row to row.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Horizontal pill tabs with a raised default-button selection indicator, gliding hover wash that never crosses the active tab, optional active-label collapse, and manual keyboard activation.

items.name: prometheus-provider
items.title: Prometheus Provider
items.description: App provider for Prometheus. Supplies isMobile, next-themes, size/shape ladders, TooltipProvider, and SurfaceProvider (substrate 1) once at the root. Use usePrometheus() instead of adding a second breakpoint hook beside every dialog or menu.

items.name: agent
items.title: Prometheus Agent Pack
items.description: Agent instructions and a Cursor skill that tell models to search Prometheus before writing UI. Installs with the base so every new project starts with the same conventions.
